name: claudecode-jev-marketplace
description: TypeSafe Jev (System One) wired into Claude Code: a decision primitive for hooks, and the Skylence herdr agent-org with Jev measuring tier and review gates.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: The opinionated Claude Code baseline (forked from core-claude 0.9.8) with TypeSafe Jev deciding the judgments core-claude spent a `claude -p` subprocess on. /core:setup installs the judge-hook rules engine, writing-guard, core-hud statusline, CLAUDE.md guidelines, the full-bypass posture gated by the judge, and the `jev` shell helper (named question sets, thresholds with a per-box overlay, cache, audit log, stub mode, fail-open); jev-intent-gate (PreToolUse; the dependency version-pin rules, two Nouls) and jev-research-nudge (Stop; hedged factual claims, one Noul) answer with Jev. /core:doctor audits it read-only. Replaces core-claude; never install both. POSIX sh + curl + jq, no SDK.

plugins.name: herdr-agent-org
plugins.description: The Skylence agent-org on the Herdr multiplexer (forked from multi-llm-marketplace's herdr-agent-org-claude 2.4.1) with Jev at two event boundaries: dispatch-worker runs a TIER GAUGE over each brief (L17 TIER BY BRIEF, measured: refuses a cheap tier on a non-mechanical brief, files [TIER-GAUGE: ...] on the todo) and review-gate-check measures the L10 review gate at accept (MANDATORY-REVIEW / WAIVABLE with the surface probabilities). One Jev request per lane per event, never per tool call. Everything else — seven role skills, filesystem board, org-relay wake plane, session-discipline hooks — is the upstream org unchanged. Requires herdr >= 0.7 and HERDR_ENV=1; install INSTEAD OF herdr-agent-org-claude, not beside it.
